surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during ALD of ZnO involved the use of diethylzinc (DEZn) and water (H2O) as precursors. Each H2O pulse was 0.1 s in duration followed by a 5 s N2 purge, and each DEZn pulse was 0.01 s in duration followed by a 5 s N2 purge. The reaction mechanism is not explicitly detailed in terms of chemical equations but is implied through the ALD process description.
